notes.title: New Horror Mode coming soon!
notes.content:
Last week we launched Escape from Kyoto House. Hundreds of you have already escaped, but what comes next?

We are already planning a new escape room, but that will take a little while to prepare. So we're doing something a little special - Escape from Kyoto House is getting a terrifying new Horror Mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37854068/ae2d9eeecf9dba2a25918604fd355a346febdb3f.png[/img]


What does that mean?
[list]
[*]New Horror Theme - Escaping is easy with the lights on. And nothing chasing you...
[*]Monsters! - Is something lurking in the dark? We don't want to spoil anything for you, but you may want to find a good hiding place.
[*]Health system - You can now die in the game, and you will only have so many lives to spend before the game ends. For multiplayer games, these lives are shared. 
[*]Remixed puzzles - You'll encounter the same puzzles, but most will require a different solution.
[/list]

This will be a 100% free update for everyone who owns the game - no DLCs, in-app purchases, freemium content or whatever you crazy kids call it these days. It will be included in the base game.

We'll get you more news ASAP, but we're hopeful to launch this very soon.

Taichi Games
